provenance.question: The clock policy is still unspecified. Should the paper trial require Windows Time using time.windows.com with a maximum reported error bound of 1 second? The last recorded bound was about 8.49 seconds, so this choice would require improving synchronization before launch; it would not authorize trading immediately.
provenance.answer: Use the 1-second bound; fix synchronization before launch

implementation_note: Windows Time currently reports the configured source as time.windows.com,0x9. The suffix is its existing peer mode, not a different hostname. No time-source change is approved by this record.
